title: Anthropic's Claude 3.7 Sonnet can answer fast or think it through, and Claude Code arrives
summary: Anthropic released Claude 3.7 Sonnet, which it called the first hybrid reasoning model: it can answer right away, or switch to an extended thinking mode where it works through a problem step by step and shows its work. Extended thinking wasn't included on the free plan. Anthropic also released a limited preview of Claude Code, a tool that works in a programmer's terminal and can read code, edit files, run tests, and push changes to GitHub.
why_it_matters: Instead of switching between a fast model and a separate reasoning model, one model can now do both. Claude Code goes beyond suggesting code: it carries out programming tasks itself.
